assertions: Prenatal GLB loads; loading clears; reduced motion disables rotation.
Keyboard rotation changes the rendered model; reset responds.
Age-one model loads, its disclaimer and downloads update.
Both model and portrait downloads return genuine GLB/PNG files.
Tab-only navigation shows focus on 21 controls/links.
Optional rotation starts only on request and stops on manual control.
Failed mesh load shows portrait, clears loading, and recovers on retry.
No automatic third-party requests or uncaught script errors.
focusItems: Interactive prenatal keepsake. Use arrow keys to rotate, plus or minus to zoom, and Home to reset.
